{{ElectionsOH}}
The '''1994 Ohio State Treasurer election''' was held on November 8, 1994, to elect the [[Ohio State Treasurer]]. Primaries were held on May 3, 1994.

Republican incumbent Ohio State Treasurer [[Ken Blackwell]], who was appointed following Democrat [[Mary Ellen Withrow]]'s resignation after being nominated to [[Treasurer of the United States]], won election to a full term, defeating the Democratic nominee [[Akron, Ohio|Akron City]] Council member [[Barbara Sykes (politician)|Barbara Sykes]] by eleven percentage points.

== Republican primary ==
=== Candidates ===
*[[Ken Blackwell]], incumbent [[Ohio State Treasurer]] (1994–1999)
=== Campaign ===
Blackwell won the Republican nomination unopposed.

== Democratic primary ==
=== Candidates ===
*[[Barbara Sykes (politician)|Barbara Sykes]], [[Akron, Ohio|Akron City]] Council member
*[[George McKelvey (mayor)|George McKelvey]], [[Mahoning County, Ohio|Mahoning County]] Treasurer
=== Campaign ===
Sykes easily won the Democratic nomination over McKelvey, winning with 62.74% of the vote.
